title: The Call of the Wild
author: Jack London
summary: Buck, a large and pampered dog, is stolen from a California home and sold into harsh work as a sled dog during the Klondike Gold Rush. He must adapt to survive and slowly answers his wild instincts.
readIf: you want a short, vivid survival story told from an animal's point of view.
skipIf: you cannot stomach cruelty to animals.
